post.summary: End an ongoing session in a Space
post.description:
Session analytics is automatically logged whenever there is at least one user in a Space. In cases where events are back to back and where analytics data is required for each event, sessions may sometimes span multiple events as there is no guarantee that participants will leave the Space between events. 

To address this, this API endpoint force ends an ongoing session. The ongoing session is then split into two sessions, one that ends when the endpoint is called, and another one that starts when the endpoint is called. All presence information is retained for the new event, but user join times are set to when the endpoint was called.

200.description: Ongoing session ended successfully. `endedSessionId` is the id of the session that was ongoing session that was terminated, while `newSessionId` is the id of the new session in this Space if there are users in the space when this endpoint was called, otherwise null is returned.

allOf.description: The new `sessionId` if available. This may be `null` if there are no users in the Space when the session is ended.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Filter events using a Base64-encoded JSON object.

The `filters` query parameter is required.

Choose the fields below, serialize the object to JSON, and Base64-encode the UTF-8 bytes. Enter the encoded value in the `filters` input. These fields belong inside the JSON object; they are not separate query parameters.

**Decoded filter fields**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timeRange` | object | Filters events by time range. All event start dates will be on or after `start`, and all end dates will be on or before `end`. |
| `timeRange.start` | string | Start date and time for the events. Format: rfc3339Timestamp. |
| `timeRange.end` | string | End date and time for the events. Format: rfc3339Timestamp. |
| `organizers` | array of strings | Filters events by organizer userIds. Each item: mongodb id (12 byte hex string). Example: `["507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"]`. |
| `attendees` | array of strings | Filters events by attendee userIds. Each item: mongodb id (12 byte hex string). Example: `["507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"]`. |
| `otherAttendees` | array of strings | Filters events by otherAttendee userIds. Each item: mongodb id (12 byte hex string). Example: `["507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"]`. |
| `sites` | array of strings | Filter by site Each item: mongodb id (12 byte hex string). Example: `["507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"]`. |
| `customAttributes` | array of strings | Filter by event custom attributes Example: `["NydvLFSpxOJe2aO07hGxU"]`. |

**Example before encoding**

```json
{
  "timeRange": {
    "start": "2024-06-30T01:00:00.000Z",
    "end": "2024-07-30T23:59:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Base64 value for the filters input**

```text
eyJ0aW1lUmFuZ2UiOnsic3RhcnQiOiIyMDI0LTA2LTMwVDAxOjAwOjAwLjAwMFoiLCJlbmQiOiIyMDI0LTA3LTMwVDIzOjU5OjAwLjAwMFoifX0=
```

**Example request**

```text
/events?filters=eyJ0aW1lUmFuZ2UiOnsic3RhcnQiOiIyMDI0LTA2LTMwVDAxOjAwOjAwLjAwMFoiLCJlbmQiOiIyMDI0LTA3LTMwVDIzOjU5OjAwLjAwMFoifX0%3D
```

**Encode inline in Node.js**

```javascript
const criteria = {"timeRange":{"start":"2024-06-30T01:00:00.000Z","end":"2024-07-30T23:59:00.000Z"}};
const params = new URLSearchParams({
  filters: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(criteria), "utf8").toString("base64")
});
const path = "/events?" + params.toString();
```

Base64 encoding and URL encoding are separate steps. An HTTP client query-parameter helper can URL-encode the Base64 value for you. If constructing the URL manually, URL-encode the value once so `+`, `/`, and `=` are preserved.

get.description:
Retrieve the details of a single Control Center alert in your institution by its `alertId`.

**Response nullability:** `triggeredBy`, `assignedTo` and `resolution` are always present in the response — when absent they are returned as explicit `null` rather than omitted from the object.

**`triggeredBy` per alert type:**
- `TEACHER_DECLINED_EVENT` — populated with the teacher who declined the event.
- `EVENT_NO_SHOW` — always `null` (the alert is triggered by the absence of the organizer, not by a specific user action).

get.description:
Returns the available coaching and safeguarding reports for a session.

Report data is derived from the session's recordings and, when available,
the safeguarding document associated with the session.

Response behavior:
- If the session has no recordings, both `coaching` and `safeguarding` are `null`.
- If recordings exist but no coaching insights are available, `coaching` is `null`.
- If no safeguarding document exists for the session, `safeguarding` is `null`.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The `sessionId` of the analytics session to retrieve reports for.

patch.description:
Update selected fields on an existing event. Unlike `PUT /events/{eventId}`, which requires the complete event object, this endpoint accepts a partial event object and only modifies the fields explicitly provided in the request body. Fields not included in the request remain unchanged. All properties in the request body are optional but at least one must be supplied.

**Editability restrictions based on event state:**
- **Past or cancelled events**: only `title`, `description` and `customAttributes` may be updated.
- **Active future events**: all listed fields may be updated.

Supplying a field that is not allowed for the event's current state will return `400 INVALID_REQUEST_BODY`.

**`type` / `spaceId` / `location` mutual exclusion:**
- For `ONLINE` events, `location` must not be supplied; if the event previously had a `location` it will be cleared.
- For `OFFLINE` events, `spaceId` must not be supplied; if the event previously had a `spaceId` it will be cleared.

**Recurring events:** the request updates only the single occurrence identified by `eventId`; there is no way via the public API to apply the change to the whole series or to "this and future" occurrences.

siteIds.description: Array of site IDs that the user belongs to. This field is only returned for institutions that are site-enabled. For institution admins, this array will be empty.

customAttributeList.description:
Array of custom attributes in the format `<keyId>:<valueKeyId>`.

Each entry consists of a key-value pair representing the custom attribute and its value. For example, `"UvOpCTDGzbiNhvjnpHTB:nmgkDIueg1v_c2CqUqOCk"` refers to the value `Math` for the custom attribute `Subjects`.

Refer to the `GET /attributes` endpoint to retrieve all available custom attributes.

participants.description: An array of `spaceUser` corresponding to Space participants

email.description: The email for this user. If `userId` is also provided, the email is ignored.

allOf.description: Only present if the event is a recurring event

timeRange.description: Filters events by time range. All event start dates will be on or after `start`, and all end dates will be on or before `end`.

url.description: The URL that will receive the webhook POST requests. Must include http:// or https://.

allOf.description: The user whose action triggered this alert (e.g. the teacher who declined the event). Always `null` for `EVENT_NO_SHOW` alerts, which are not triggered by a specific user.

Details about when and by whom the alert was closed. `null` while the alert is still `OPEN` or `ASSIGNED`.

Filter criteria for sessions.

spaceIds.description: The ids associated with the object in the filter.

createdStart.description: The time range associated with filtering the object by its created date (start).

createdEnd.description: The time range associated with filtering the object by its created date (end).

editedStart.description: The time range associated with filtering the object by its last edited date (start).

editedEnd.description: The time range associated with filtering the object by its last edited date (end).

status.description: Filters the sessions by status. If not specified, only `processed` sessions are returned by default.

callsOnly.description: Filters sessions to only return sessions with calls

billedOnly.description: Filters sessions to only return sessions with billed Space time

spacesFilterSchema.description:
Filter criteria for Spaces.

This schema describes the decoded JSON object for the `filters` query parameter on GET /spaces. Serialize the object to JSON, then Base64-encode the UTF-8 bytes before sending. The parameter description lists every field inline.

query.description: The search key you'd like to search as part of the filter. This typically matches the title of the object and is a substring match.

owner.description: Filter by a particular Space owner userId.

externalId.description: Filter by a particular Space externalId.

archiveStatus.description: Whether to show or hide archived Spaces

The starting time of the recording, measured in UTC epoch time in seconds

examples: This is a detailed description of the test event.

type.description: The type of event. `ONLINE` events take place in a Pencil Space; `OFFLINE` events take place at a physical `location`.

location.description: The physical location of the event. Applicable only for `OFFLINE` events.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the event. Optional; if omitted, the API caller's timezone settings are used.

siteId.description: The ID of the site linked to the event. This field is optional and applicable only for institutions with the sites feature enabled.

allOf.description: The recurrence rule for the event. This field is optional and should only be included for recurring events.

rule.description:
The recurrence rule for the event, following the iCalendar RFC 554 format
**Important Guidelines:**
- The `DTSTART`, `DTEND`, and `TZID` lines are **not** allowed in this field; event start and end times should be specified in the `startTime` and `endTime` fields respectively.
- The timezone for the recurrence is inferred from the event's start time.If the start time is specified in UTC, the API will use the API caller's timezone settings.
- Exactly one of either `COUNT` or `UNTIL` must be provided. Supplying both or neither will result in an error.

email.description: The email for this user. Note if `userId` is also provided, this email is ignored

allOf.description: The `userId` for this user

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier the `slots` times are expressed in. Optional; defaults to `Etc/UTC` when omitted.
